versions.changelog:
Structured Notes Generator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Converts topics, lecture PDFs, or transcripts into structured study notes.
- Extracts and organizes key concepts, definitions, examples, and an outline by topic and subtopic.
- Highlights concept relationships and adds a visual outline (concept map).
- Automatically generates 3-5 review questions.
- Flags concepts needing more context as [需要扩展].
- Ensures technical accuracy and keeps notes concise (500-1500 words unless necessary).
